title: Good Idea that Didn't Work
text: Good Idea that Didn't Work. I liked the idea that the strainer was hands-free but didn't realize that I would have to burn my fingers putting it on when ready to drain and its very hard to attach even when pot isn't hot. Boo Hiss.

product_metadata.title: Better Strainer As Seen On TV - Expandable Colander For Any Pot Pan Or Bowl
features: The strainer is easy to use and eliminates kitchen mess
